choice: A speed against recorded distance (primary) · B tangential acceleration against speed, rising phase (secondary) · C speed against elapsed time (control)
justification: Fixed by the Milestone 2 brief; it supersedes the single `alignment` choice left pending in notebook 01. C is kept as the control because the recording clock starts at an arbitrary moment of the run.
evidence: notebook 01, integrated ICC of the aligned curve, position-adjusted — speed by distance: design 0.754, confirm 0.837; a_tan by speed_phase: design 0.364, confirm 0.416; speed by elapsed_time: design 0.230, confirm 0.575

choice: speed and a_tan as values; dist, speed and t_rel as axes; no lateral channel
justification: FPCA is fitted one channel at a time. a_lat, lat_dev, yaw_rate and head_sin change sign under a mirror image of the run and the handedness of the Combine frame is unverified, so they are left out.
evidence: undefined real frames of t_rel / dist / speed; shares of undefined real frames per channel: t_rel 0.00 %, dist 0.00 %, along 0.00 %, speed 0.00 %, a_tan 0.03 %, a_lat 0.03 %, yaw_rate 3.45 %, lat_dev 0.00 %, head_sin 3.45 %, head_cos 3.45 %, pos_resid 0.00 %

choice: kept: t_s per frame in sequence_frames, t_orig per grid point on every aligned curve
justification: An aligned value can always be traced back to its frames; no representation replaces the clock.
evidence: t_s (seconds since the trajectory's first valid frame, Phase 03) increases on every frame of every sequence · 0 of 40707 frame steps differ from 0.1 s; every alignment interpolates on the recorded clock, so an irregular step is used as recorded, not assumed regular

choice: carried per sequence as diagnostics (sequence_window_flags); never a filter, never a model input
justification: Phase 03 `end_censored` is true for every forty attempt, so the continuous window variables and four explicit flags are used instead. Filtering on them would select athletes by how they were recorded.
evidence: starts in motion 58.5 %, starts above the reference speed 0.4 %, ends at top speed 83.1 %, peak on the last frame 28.1 % of 793 sequences

choice: padded cells are zero and masked in the sequence array; aligned curves are NaN outside the recording
justification: A padded or unrecorded cell is never an observation: means, covariances and scores use observed points only.
evidence: 41,500 real frames and 29,870 padded cells in 793 sequences; padded cells are exactly zero, flagged by `mask`, and aligned curves hold NaN (not zero) outside the recording

choice: no imputation; an undefined frame leaves the neighbouring grid points undefined
justification: The axis channels are always defined; a_tan is undefined on a handful of frames, which interpolation does not bridge.
evidence: undefined real frames of t_rel / dist / speed; shares of undefined real frames per channel: t_rel 0.00 %, dist 0.00 %, along 0.00 %, speed 0.00 %, a_tan 0.03 %, a_lat 0.03 %, yaw_rate 3.45 %, lat_dev 0.00 %, head_sin 3.45 %, head_cos 3.45 %, pos_resid 0.00 %

choice: a_tan is masked on smoothing-boundary frames in B (kept in the alternate B′); speed keeps every frame
justification: Acceleration is a second derivative of a locally fitted polynomial and is least reliable at the segment edges (Phase 03 A3: peaks concentrate on boundary frames). Dropping the same frames for speed would remove the start and the end of every run, which is where athletes differ.
evidence: sequences whose flagged boundary frames differ from 2 × 3 (the Savitzky–Golay half-window at each edge); median share of boundary frames per sequence 0.118

choice: support = longest run of grid points observed for ≥ 80 % of the training weight; a curve is scored when it covers ≥ 50 % of the support; scores are best linear predictions from its observed points
justification: Nothing is extrapolated to fit or to score. A reconstruction outside a curve's recorded range is model-implied, labelled as such, and excluded from every error.
evidence: A_speed_by_distance: 99.7 % of grid points × sequences observed; 0 of 793 sequences have no value on the grid and cannot be scored; B_accel_by_speed: 79.5 % of grid points × sequences observed; 0 of 793 sequences have no value on the grid and cannot be scored; C_speed_by_time: 85.7 % of grid points × sequences observed; 0 of 793 sequences have no value on the grid and cannot be scored; A_alt_origin_at_ref_speed: 98.8 % of grid points × sequences observed; 3 of 793 sequences have no value on the grid and cannot be scored; B_alt_boundary_kept: 88.2 % of grid points × sequences observed; 0 of 793 sequences have no value on the grid and cannot be scored; C_alt_origin_at_ref_speed: 78.8 % of grid points × sequences observed; 3 of 793 sequences have no value on the grid and cannot be scored

choice: S0_all for fitting and for the primary evaluation; S2_signal and S3_no_boundary as reliability sensitivities
justification: Stricter scenarios cost repeated athletes and select on signal quality; they are reported, not applied.
evidence: athletes with a repeat: S0_all 375, S2_signal 333, S3_no_boundary 254

choice: training-fold mean function; scores divided by the square root of the training eigenvalue; one unit of weight per athlete; no per-curve scaling
justification: Per-curve scaling would remove speed level, the main difference between athletes. Every learned quantity (support, mean, covariance, basis, eigenfunctions, noise variance) comes from the training athletes of the fold.
evidence: synthetic check fit_uses_training_athletes_only (above) and the leakage assertion of every fold fit (section 4)

choice: split registry of notebook 00, unchanged; outer folds only
justification: Athletes, never attempts, are assigned to folds. The number of components is compared, not tuned, so the inner folds are not used in notebook 02.
evidence: the seven checks of notebook 00 re-run on the registry as loaded: one_outer_fold_per_athlete_and_repeat = ok; every_eligible_sequence_has_a_fold = ok; all_attempts_of_an_athlete_share_a_fold = ok; every_outer_fold_is_populated = ok; inner_folds_partition_every_outer_training_set = ok; design_role_is_constant_per_athlete = ok; split_uses_position_and_cohort_only = ok

choice: synthetic fixtures only; production data unaffected; the warning is now silenced in fixtures and guarded in production
justification: Every occurrence in the executed notebook 00 is in the synthetic-validation cell. The production manifest carries the sprint-rescue flags on every eligible sequence.
evidence: eligible sequences without sprint-rescue flags (793 checked). Non-zero means the manifest was built on the quality-tier fallback: rerun the sprint rescue, then notebook 00
